Academic Levels

GETI Academic Pathways

Public overview of GETI Baccalaureat and University pathways. Detailed curricula, semester subjects and student records are available in the student portal.

Level 1

GETI Baccalaureat

Foundation-level academic pathway designed to prepare students for higher study and professional specialization.

Suggested duration: 1 academic year
Level 2

Bachelor / Licence (L1–L3)

Undergraduate-level pathway with core modules, specialization courses, assessments and a final academic project.

University duration: 3 academic years • 180 ECTS
Level 3

Master Year 1 (M1)

Advanced study focused on specialization, research methods, professional analysis and higher-level coursework.

Year 4 • S7 + S8 • 60 ECTS
Level 4

Master Degree (M2)

Final advanced-level pathway with specialist modules, research or professional thesis work and final evaluation.

Year 5 • S9 + S10 • 60 ECTS + Thesis
GETI Baccalaureat→ Bachelor / Licence (L1–L3)→ Master Year 1 (M1)→ Master Degree (M2)
Academic titles, accreditation and recognition must only be presented as officially recognized where GETI can support the claim with valid documentation from the relevant authority.
Institution Profile

About GETI

The first area should help visitors quickly understand what GETI offers, how the academic structure works and what students can expect before signing in.

Structured online learning with a clear academic pathway

GETI can organize its public academic presence around transparent institutional information, programme discovery, admissions, academic regulations and official document verification. This first area acts as the public face of the platform.

Visitors should be able to understand the difference between GETI Baccalaureat and GETI University, see the general progression from level to level, identify available faculties and know how to move from public information into a secure student account.

For a professional presentation, the first area should balance visual attractiveness and useful academic information: what GETI is, how the system works, what students can study and how records are managed.

Mission

Provide accessible, structured online learning with lessons, assessments, academic records and student support.

Vision

Develop a reliable digital academic environment with verifiable records and professional student services.

Values

Integrity, transparency, accessibility, academic discipline, support and continuous improvement.

Academic Programmes

Faculties & Programme Catalogue

The first area should present the programme families clearly. Each group below represents a public entry point before a student opens the detailed subject-by-subject learning path inside the portal.

15 Filières

Faculty of Science & Engineering

Includes Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Environmental Science, Hydrogeology, Water Science, Geology, Geotechnical Engineering and related scientific pathways.

15 Filières

Faculty of Economics, Business & Social Sciences

Includes Economics, Finance, Accounting, Marketing, International Business, Human Resource Management, Public Administration and development-oriented pathways.

15 Filières

Faculty of IT & Computer Science

Includes Computer Science, Software Engineering, Web & Mobile Development, Databases, Networks, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, AI and digital technology.

15 Filières

Faculty of Arts & Humanities

Includes Anglophone Studies, Francophone Studies, Tourism, Hospitality, Communication, History, Geography, Philosophy, Sociology, Law and related disciplines.

Programme pages can explain duration, entry requirements, credits, learning outcomes, career opportunities and progression rules. Public visitors do not need to see the full private academic dashboard, but they should understand that each programme eventually leads to semesters, subjects, lessons, assignments, quizzes, exams, transcripts and diploma services in the second area.

Admissions

Admission & Registration Pathway

The public first area should explain how a visitor becomes a student and reaches the second area.

01

Create Account

Create a student account with identity, email, country and contact information.

02

Choose Pathway

Registration Review

Student Experience

What the GETI learning environment can include

This first area can also showcase the learner experience visually so that visitors understand the platform before they register.

Research & Academic Writing

From early coursework to L3 project work and M2 thesis preparation, students can progressively build research skills and academic writing habits.

Digital Learning Tools

The platform can host PDF lessons, books, references, announcements, assessments, feedback and academic records in one organized environment.

Progression to Diploma

Students can move through levels, accumulate credits, complete assessments and eventually reach transcript generation, graduation clearance and diploma issuance.

Academic Regulations

Key Academic Rules

Essential regulations are public; detailed student-specific results remain private.

50%Minimum academic pass mark
75%Minimum attendance requirement
30 ECTSPer University semester
60 ECTSPer University academic year
ResitRetake session where applicable
IntegrityPlagiarism and cheating prohibited

Progression, prerequisites, internship, final project, thesis, grading, resit, appeals and graduation rules are detailed further inside the student portal and academic regulations pages. The public area should summarize them clearly while keeping private student records protected.

Institutional Transparency

Accreditation & Recognition

GETI should publish only claims that can be supported with official documentation.

No unverified accreditation claim is displayed on this public page.

If an official accreditation, recognition, registration, membership or approval is obtained, the public record should show the issuing body, reference number, scope, validity dates and supporting evidence. This helps the public understand exactly what status GETI has and avoids any misleading claim.

Official Records

Diploma Verification

Verify a diploma using a Diploma ID, Student ID or student name.

Production verification should query the official GETI database/API. QR verification can resolve to the same registry, and the result should only expose the minimum information needed to confirm authenticity.

News & Events

Academic Updates

Public announcements should include admissions, rentrée, examinations, seminars and graduation information.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ

How do I register?

Create an account, complete admission and registration, then select the available academic pathway.

Where can I see my subjects?

After sign-in, open GETI School and choose your level, filière, semester and subject.

How are grades calculated?

The academic system combines continuous assessment and exam results and records grades, credits, average and GPA.

How can I verify a diploma?

Use the public verification form with Diploma ID, Student ID or Name.

What happens if I fail an exam?

The system supports resit/rattrapage according to the applicable academic rules.

Where can I request support?

Students can use the Help Desk after sign-in; general inquiries can use the public contact details below.

Academic progression:
L1 → L2 → L3 = same principal filière.
M1 = choose 1 specialisation from the 5 available for the principal filière.

University Curriculum: each semester now displays named subjects matching the selected filière. Subjects are different from one semester to the next. M1 and M2 subjects are generated from the selected specialisation.

Security & Governance

Roles, Permissions & Data Security

RoleStudent RecordsGradesPaymentsDiplomasSystem Settings
StudentOwn record onlyRead ownRead ownRead ownNo
TeacherAssigned classesCreate / grade assignedNoNoNo
RegistrarManage academic recordsRead / validateRead statusPrepare / verifyNo
FinanceIdentity + billingNoManageClearance statusNo
AdminManageManageRead / manageManageLimited
Super AdminFullFullFullFullFull

Production Security Architecture

Authentication

Password hashing must be server-side. Admin / Super Admin should use 2FA. Session tokens should be secure, short-lived and revocable.

Rate Limiting

Protect sign-in, exam-code validation, verification and public APIs with rate limiting and abuse monitoring.

Data Storage

Use Cloudflare D1 for structured records and Cloudflare R2 for PDF/document storage. Avoid sensitive production records stored only in browser local storage.

Backup & Recovery

Scheduled D1 exports, R2 file copies, versioning/retention where available, encrypted offline backups, restore tests and documented incident recovery.

Governance

Audit Logs

Track who changed grades, diplomas, student data and administrative records, and when.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I access a course?
Open GETI School → University → Level → Filière → Semester → Subject.

What is the passing mark?
The default academic rule is 50% with required attendance. Failed exams can use the resit session.

How do I get a diploma?
Complete the required level, credits, assessments, internship/project/thesis requirements, then the admin can issue an eligible diploma.

Contact & Technical Support

Email: info@getienglish.com

For account, course access, examination, transcript or verification support.

Academic Governance

Terms & Academic Policies

Academic Integrity

Plagiarism, fabricated evidence, unauthorized collaboration and cheating are prohibited. Submitted work must be the student's own and sources must be acknowledged.

Examination Conduct

Students must follow exam instructions, use their own identity and exam code, and must not obtain unauthorized assistance.

Discipline

Academic or behavioral misconduct may be reviewed by the administration and can lead to warnings, resit restrictions, suspension or other documented measures.

Appeals

Students may request review of grades, academic decisions or disciplinary decisions according to the published GETI appeal process and deadlines.

Data Protection

Privacy & Student Data Protection

Student records should be accessible only to authorized users. Production deployment should use authenticated roles, encrypted connections, controlled D1 access, private R2 objects where appropriate, audit logs, retention rules and recovery procedures.

Public verification should expose only the minimum information needed to verify a diploma record.

Refund policy: fees, refunds, cancellations and administrative charges should be governed by a published finance policy and reflected in the student's invoice and payment history.

Acceptable use: accounts, assessment systems, messaging and digital library access must be used only for authorized academic purposes.

This downloadable HTML is a frontend prototype. Sensitive production records should not be stored only in browser local storage.
